scenes.title: Buying one? Check these 5 things first.
Ask for the receipt.
scenes.body: The 2UZ-FE uses a belt. No paperwork? Assume the 90k service is due.

scenes.title: Know which one you're buying.
scenes.body: 1998–99 trucks have the two-pinion diff that fails most under shock loads.

scenes.title: Have they been done?
scenes.body: The plastic tees go brittle and crack, dumping coolant.

scenes.title: Listen for a tick.
scenes.body: It can be a spark plug working loose. Check the plugs first.

scenes.title: Look at the wishbones.
scenes.body: Check for cracks, and play in the lower ball joints and CV boots.
